name: @taowind/reality-simulation-runtime
description: Reality-native authoritative spatial simulation with exact Capsule-OBB collision, friction warm starts, deterministic constraint islands, island sleep, coyote time, jump buffering and v0.7 network state compatibility.

scripts.test: npm run build && node dist/tests/run.js && node dist/tests/simulation.js && node dist/tests/constraint-physics.js && node dist/tests/embodied-dynamics.js && node dist/tests/experience-fabric.js && node dist/tests/spatial-embodiment.js && node dist/tests/network-reconciliation.js
scripts.demo:simulation: npm run build && node dist/packages/simulation-cli/src/cli.js demo outputs/simulation-demo
scripts.verify:simulation: npm run build && node dist/packages/simulation-cli/src/cli.js verify outputs/simulation-verify
scripts.verify:release: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run audit:release
scripts.demo:constraint-physics: npm run build && node dist/packages/constraint-physics-cli/src/cli.js demo outputs/constraint-physics-demo
scripts.verify:constraint-physics: npm run build && node dist/packages/constraint-physics-cli/src/cli.js verify outputs/constraint-physics-verify
scripts.demo:embodied-dynamics: npm run build && node dist/packages/embodied-dynamics-cli/src/cli.js demo outputs/embodied-dynamics-demo
scripts.verify:embodied-dynamics: npm run build && node dist/packages/embodied-dynamics-cli/src/cli.js verify outputs/embodied-dynamics-verify
scripts.demo:experience-fabric: npm run build && node dist/packages/experience-fabric-cli/src/cli.js demo outputs/experience-fabric-demo
scripts.verify:experience-fabric: npm run build && node dist/packages/experience-fabric-cli/src/cli.js verify outputs/experience-fabric-verify
scripts.demo:spatial-embodiment: npm run build && node dist/packages/spatial-embodiment-cli/src/cli.js demo outputs/spatial-embodiment-demo
scripts.verify:spatial-embodiment: npm run build && node dist/packages/spatial-embodiment-cli/src/cli.js verify outputs/spatial-embodiment-verify
scripts.benchmark:all: npm run benchmark:simulation && npm run benchmark:constraint-physics && npm run benchmark:embodied-dynamics && npm run benchmark:experience-fabric && npm run benchmark:spatial-embodiment
